about.text: Paskha is a festive Easter dish of Eastern Orthodox countries, eaten at the end of Lent. It is made of curd pressed in a mould, in a cooked version with an egg custard and in an uncooked one.

facts.v: Also kept by the Orthodox Karelian Easter tradition in Finland, made with rahka, cream, sugar, egg and butter
